reviews.review_text:
Trail626170
1 contribution
0
Great variety, delicious dishes
Aug 2026 • Friends
We have been eating at Quan Bui since 2012 when there was only one in downtown. Now there are multiple locations. It is our favorite Vietnamese restaurant. They have a huge variety of dishes and they are all good. It is best to do family style and get many different dishes to share. The clay pot dishes are especially nice like pork & coconut or honey chicken. We prefer the Garden restaurant in Thao Dien for atmosphere. Since it is higher priced place than many VN restaurants, we go for special occasions like birthdays, visitors in town, etc.

Aug 2026 • Business
A place I never forget when I come to Ho Chi Minh City 
It is a place where you can enjoy Vietnamese food without worry, regardless of who you are with. 

I personally like buying seaweeds and stir-fried garlic. Taste. Cleanliness I am mostly satisfied with the service.
The price is a little high for local food, but that's not bad either. 

This is a local restaurant that Korean customers love very much.

Dear Guest / 고객님께,

Thank you so much for always visiting Quán Bụi Garden when you are in Ho Chi Minh City and for sharing such a wonderful review! We are thrilled that you and your companions can always enjoy our Vietnamese dishes comfortably. It is great to know that our Bánh Xèo and Stir-fried Chayote with garlic are your favorites. We truly appreciate your compliments on our taste, cleanliness, and service. We always strive to use premium ingredients and maintain high standards to ensure your experience is always worth it. It is a great honor to be loved by our Korean guests. We can't wait to welcome you back on your next trip!

호치민에 오실 때마다 항상 꽌부이 가든을 찾아주시고 멋진 리뷰를 남겨주셔서 대단히 감사합니다! 일행분들과 함께 호불호 없이 저희 베트남 음식을 즐겨주신다니 정말 기쁩니다. 고객님의 최애 메뉴인 반쎄오와 수수마늘볶음이 만족스러우셨다니 다행입니다. 맛, 청결, 서비스에 대한 칭찬에도 깊이 감사드립니다. 저희는 항상 고객님께 가치 있는 경험을 선사하기 위해 최고급 식재료와 높은 기준을 유지하고자 노력하고 있습니다. 한국 고객님들께 큰 사랑을 받아 영광입니다. 다음 여행 때 꼭 다시 뵙기를 기대하겠습니다!
